Settled extent of each colony before 1763, Maine and Vermont, Virginia's growth 1607-1700, the French and Indian War front and the 1775-76 war are not on the five pages opened; colonies enter as modern states at their founding year

Post dates beyond Charles Fort 1668, Moose Factory 1673 and York Factory 1684; Fort Albany; the 1763 and 1774 effects on the Hudson Bay boundary; the end of the 1821 licence (1859); the Red River Colony grant of 1811
The 1763 boundaries (45th parallel), Anticosti and the Magdalen Islands, the 1775-76 American invasion, British forts south of the lakes held until 1796
Extent of the Russian claim before 1825 (Ukase of 1821), end of the 1839 HBC lease, the infobox area (garbled on the extract), Tlingit wars
Sunbury County's eastern Maine claim of 1765 and its end, the 1755 deportation date, the Massachusetts boundary
French Shore rights (1783, 1904), St Pierre and Miquelon, area before 1927, capital spans before 1907

problems: All sixteen dossiers are new states with cliopatria_names []. thirteen-colonies, dominion-of-newfoundland, rupert-s-land, the Canadas, the Maritime colonies, British Columbia and the Floridas overlap cells that Cliopatria draws inside english-colonial-empire / british-colonial-empire / british-empire; the colour and render agents must choose one drawing for each year.

Counterpart strings to reconcile: canada (am-07-d) uses hudson-s-bay-company-lands for the 1870 gain (this batch: rupert-s-land) and british-colonial-empire for the 1867, 1871 and 1873 gains (the matching losses are in province-of-canada, colony-of-nova-scotia, colony-of-new-brunswick, colony-of-british-columbia, colony-of-prince-edward-island); spanish-florida and new-france name british-colonial-empire where these dossiers name spanish-florida and new-france; new-netherland names english-colonial-empire for the 1664 loss, thirteen-colonies names new-netherland.
Wikidata ids are null in every dossier (wikidata.org unreachable, Cliopatria has no row).
Several capital spans are the researcher's readings (flagged in each capital note); the Province of Canada capital spans end one year early so they do not overlap.

Keyframe shapes of thirteen-colonies before 1763 are modern states at the founding year (overstating the settled area); the Proclamation Line, the Labrador coastal strip and the Vancouver Island outline are researcher polygons.

The dominion-of-newfoundland dossier covers the colony (1610) and the dominion as one state under the slug the Canada dossier already uses; the display name may need to be a neutral Newfoundland if the site labels by name.
WebFetch returns a summary of the page, not the page: infoboxes of the New Brunswick and Prince Edward Island articles and several dates did not load and are marked in the notes.
